note: WI-10: member-scoped personal knowledge (knowledge/personal/members/<member_id>/...), including training.json (training-catalog.ts) and, for work inventory, work-inventory/consents/*.json (work-inventory-consent.ts — recording consent grants/revocations; kept while active and retained as audit evidence after revocation or expiry, the same review_required+audit norm this catalog uses for other consent/authorization evidence) and work-inventory/observations/*.json (work-inventory-observation.ts — desktop/browser recording summaries carrying a `pending_review|confirmed|discarded` status field inside each file). WI-16: the directory itself stays review_required (member_id is a variable segment, and confirmed observations plus training.json must never be swept by a blind TTL), but the two status_rules below close the per-file gap: a pending_review summary that is never confirmed, or a discarded summary, each expire 30 days after their own status transition — confirmed summaries and consent records are never matched by either rule and are never auto-deleted. Status rules are the one explicit, opt-in exception to 'review_required never deletes': a rule's own action 'delete' deletes only files matching its path_pattern whose status is one of its statuses and past its ttl.
